title.narrative: Promoting Peace-Building Opportunities through Multi-Skills Training

description.narrative: The project will target vulnerable beneficiaries (unemployed, poor, ex-combatants, single-headed households etc.) from the identified communities with a strong emphasis on youth beneficiaries. The participation of Liberia#s youth in the training courses will be es sential to meet the demands of the present industrial growth. It is envisioned that the project will train between 250 # 350 beneficiary groups. The project will aim to target a minimum of 50% youth for all training activities. To contribute to the national Government#s Poverty Reduction Strategy aimed at revitalizing the economy (Pillar II) in the sectors of agriculture, forestry, mining manufacturing and services. More specifically the objective is to provide vulnerable beneficiaries and youth with marketable skills for increased self-employment, enterprise creation and income generation opportunities. The project activities will focus on the following: - Develop marketable technical skills for beneficiaries through certified industry training in the fields of welding, heavy equipment mechanics and maintenance operations. - Develop complimentary entrepreneurial skills to assist the beneficiaries in starting micro enterprises. - Strengthen institutional capacity of Liberia#s technical and vocational training centers including relevant local non-gov
